long_biography.plain_text:
AURELIUS grew from an investment model focused on buying companies in special situations and improving them through hands-on operational work. Dirk Markus and Gert Purkert established the first entity in 2005, then broadened the platform from lower-mid-market private equity into private debt, growth investments and real estate. The business later extended its operations across Europe, North America and Asia.

Markus brought restructuring and digital-business experience from McKinsey, followed by founding the procurement platform Mercateo and helping build a listed industrial holding company. His role at AURELIUS developed from co-founder and chief executive into founding partner. He continues to write on private-equity strategy and holds supervisory-board responsibilities alongside his investment work.
